scope: Prioritized primary-source discoveries, not an exhaustive bibliography or an assertion that every paper contains wholly new formulas.
verification: Full-text/abstract review and repository overlap audit only; candidates are not executable imports or independently benchmarked results.

papers.title: Faster Complete Addition Laws for Montgomery Curves
formula_locations: Section 4, Theorem 2, equations (33)-(34): linear extended-coordinate maps
Section 5, equations (40)-(45); Table 3 and Appendix: completeness conditions and curve examples
papers.repository_gap: montgom has only xz; no extended Montgomery representation or cited 2024 formulas.

applicability.curve25519: Direct candidate; paper Appendix lists Curve25519 for the conditional 8M+1D law (44).

notes: Published in TCHES 2024(4), pp. 737-762, DOI 10.46586/tches.v2024.i4.737-762. Costs are paper-reported; not benchmarked here.
This includes new scaled Edwards variants; overlap with HWCD08 must be checked by identity, not just operation count.

papers.title: Faster Montgomery and double-add ladders for short Weierstrass curves
formula_locations: Figures 3-5: two Montgomery ladder states and a Joye ladder state
Sections 2.4 and 3: setup, finish, exceptional cases and completeness
papers.repository_gap: No Hamburg source or corresponding coupled ladder states in native shortw formula files.

applicability.p256: Direct short-Weierstrass candidate; no rational 2-torsion required.
applicability.curve25519: Can compare via shortw, but native Montgomery arithmetic is a separate baseline.

notes: 8M+3S+7A per bit is paper-reported for a ladder step, not a full scalar multiplication or a universal winner.
Author code: https://github.com/bitwiseshiftleft/ladder_formulas
The word Montgomery describes the ladder algorithm here; it does not imply a Montgomery curve model.

papers.title: LadderPrime: Exception-Free, Twist-Insensitive, and Constant-Time Ladder for Prime-Order Elliptic Curves
formula_locations: Theorems 1-4: generic XZ doubling and additive/multiplicative differential formulas
Algorithm 1: LadderPrime; Appendix: verification script
papers.repository_gap: No source or algorithm matching this paper; existing shortw/xz has older differential formulas.

applicability.p256: Generic short-Weierstrass/Kummer-line candidate, subject to exact theorem and algorithm hypotheses.

notes: Published March 19, 2026, DOI 10.55859/ijiss.1867564.
Standalone differential formulas retain input restrictions. Whole-algorithm exception handling must be audited; do not label an individual formula complete based on the title.

papers.title: Scalar Multiplication on Weierstrass Elliptic Curves from Co-Z Arithmetic
formula_locations: Algorithm 1: ZADDU
Algorithm 8: ZADDC (conjugate addition)
Section 4.4: DBLU/TPLU
Section 5 and appendices: fused and XY-only states
papers.repository_gap: Meloni 2007 zadd is present in jacobian, jacobian-0, jacobian-3; the joint update/conjugate operation interfaces and cited 2011 source are absent.

applicability.curve25519: Available on a shortw model, with conversion costs.

notes: Co-Z is a shared-denominator state invariant, not a new curve equation. Tests must verify both outputs and preservation of the shared denominator.

papers.title: Fast, uniform, and compact scalar multiplication for elliptic curves and genus 2 Jacobians with applications to signature schemes
formula_locations: Algorithms 1-3: project/pseudomultiply/recover and two-dimensional chain
Sections 5.1-5.3: elliptic Montgomery, Edwards, Weierstrass recovery
papers.repository_gap: No native recovery operation. Many underlying xADD/xDBL formulas are already in EFD, so do not count all of this paper as new formulas.
notes: Recovery requires a signed anchor and neighboring quotient point, with torsion and denominator conditions. A lone quotient coordinate is not invertible.

papers.title: qDSA: Small and Secure Digital Signatures with Curve-based Diffie-Hellman Key Pairs
formula_locations: Section 3.2, Proposition 3, equations (2)-(5): biquadratic relation
Algorithm 2: Check/BValues
papers.repository_gap: No quotient relation-check operation in native formula types; the new relation-profile tool is related algebra, not a qDSA implementation.

applicability.p256: Use an appropriate generic Weierstrass analogue, not this specialized Montgomery formula.

notes: Useful to catalog as an unordered sum/difference relation, not full-point addition.
Relevant to polynomial relation experiments; no index-calculus complexity claim follows.

papers.title: Differential Addition on Twisted Edwards Curves
formula_locations: Section 4: w-coordinate differential addition/doubling families
Section 4: recovery algorithms and character-dependent specializations
papers.repository_gap: No twisted quotient coordinate family or cited differential source. Edwards yz/yzsquared already exist, but under c=1 and square-d constraints.

applicability.curve25519: General w=d*x^2*y^2 route is a candidate; degree/sign/cofactor ambiguity must be retained. Check roots for each alternate w.
applicability.p256: No direct base-field twisted Edwards model.

notes: Related ACISP 2017 DOI: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-59870-3_21 . Do not count the 2026 deposit as an independent new scheme without version comparison.
Not every invariant w is degree two; the w=d*x^2*y^2 family identifies extra torsion cosets.

papers.title: Differences among Summation Polynomials over Various Forms of Elliptic Curves
formula_locations: Publisher abstract confirms Hessian/Montgomery/(twisted) Edwards/Weierstrass comparison; exact formula and experiment sections not accessible.
papers.repository_gap: No cited paper or model-specific summation-polynomial catalog. Existing f3 profile covers one relation transported between three presentations.

applicability.curve25519: Directly relevant research question; concrete applicability needs full-text review.
applicability.p256: Same; field regime and factor-base choices must be checked.

notes: DOI 10.1587/transfun.E102.A.1061. Abstract reports empirical differences. No specific prime-field degree, solver cost or 256-bit speedup verified here.

papers.title: Compression for trace zero points on twisted Edwards curves
formula_locations: Definition 9: explicit Edwards f3 and resultant recursion
Theorem 10: summation-polynomial properties
Remark 14: symmetry/support and compression comparisons
papers.repository_gap: No literature-provenance entry or symbolic resultant-recursion family; existing relation_profile supplies a related three-variable polynomial only.

applicability.curve25519: The f3 identity is usable on its Edwards model. Trace-zero compression experiments are extension-field results.
applicability.p256: No direct Edwards model over the base field.

notes: The paper studies trace-zero subgroups over extensions; its measured compression costs do not establish prime-field relation-collection costs.

papers.title: On Kummer Lines With Full Rational 2-torsion and Their Usage in Cryptography
formula_locations: Propositions 3.1-3.2 and Theorem 3.4: maps among Kummer/Montgomery/Edwards presentations
papers.repository_gap: edwards yz/yzsquared already capture some older theta-based formulas. Explicit six-model map network and translation by 2-torsion are not represented.

applicability.curve25519: Full rational 2-torsion assumption fails for Curve25519 itself; alternative examples are different curves.

notes: The (159,5) Kummer example over the same prime is not a coordinate rewrite of Curve25519.

papers.title: The geometry of efficient arithmetic on elliptic curves
formula_locations: Section 2: projective embeddings and addition-law spaces
Section 6, Theorem 6.11: rational-2-torsion models and doubling
papers.repository_gap: No explicit projective-embedding search framework or corresponding model catalog. Some classical model families overlap EFD.

applicability.curve25519: Rational-2-torsion families are candidates; test exact parameter conditions.
applicability.p256: General embedding framework applies; specialized torsion speed claims do not.

notes: Degree-4 models are intersections of quadrics; higher-degree embeddings offer additional relations and variables. This is a systematic search space, not a finite list of unrelated names.

papers.title: Twisted mu4-normal form for elliptic curves
formula_locations: Odd-characteristic linear isomorphism to twisted Edwards; binary-field addition/doubling sections
papers.repository_gap: No mu4-normal or twisted mu4 coordinate files.

applicability.curve25519: Odd-characteristic Edwards-related embedding candidate; check full conditions.
applicability.p256: Do not infer an Edwards conversion from binary-field coverage.

notes: Primary author paper: https://www.i2m.univ-amu.fr/perso/david.kohel/pub/ec_mu4_twist.pdf
Reported 9M+2S and 2M+5S+2m bounds are for binary fields, not for P-256.

papers.title: Huff's Model for Elliptic Curves
formula_locations: Addition/doubling formulas and model maps; exact equation numbers need PDF review.
papers.repository_gap: No Huff model exported; not among the ten large-characteristic EFD shapes in this audit.

applicability.curve25519: Standard Huff requires Z/4 x Z/2; Curve25519 lacks full rational 2-torsion.
applicability.p256: Excluded over base field by rational 2-torsion requirement.

notes: Include as a family in a general atlas, not as a presumed transformation for the target curves.

papers.title: Elliptic curves in Huff's model
formula_locations: General Huff equation x*(a*y^2-1)=y*(b*x^2-1); projective addition/doubling.
notes: Primary abstract supplies the full-rational-2-torsion correspondence; verify exact maps and exceptional sets before importing.

papers.title: Efficient ECM factorization in parallel with the Lyness map
formula_locations: Section 2, equations (8)-(11): Lyness curve and Weierstrass mapping
Sections 3-4: P1 x P1 arithmetic and parallel evaluation
papers.repository_gap: No Lyness/QRT biquadratic model or product-projective coordinates.

applicability.curve25519: Candidate only after explicit parameter-map and good-reduction checks.
applicability.p256: Potential model-search direction; no conversion for the specific finite-field curve established here.

notes: Fixed-point translation is not arbitrary addition. The paper studies ECM and curves over Q; quoted small-constant and four-processor costs cannot be compared directly to generic curve arithmetic.

papers.title: Division Polynomials for Jacobi Quartic Curves
formula_locations: Division-polynomial recurrences; exact numbered equations require full PDF review.
papers.repository_gap: Jacobi quartic family omitted by the export; general multiplication recurrences extend beyond the upstream operation list.

applicability.curve25519: Requires an explicit base-field Jacobi-quartic model and parameter checks.
applicability.p256: Standard rational-2-torsion quartic family is obstructed over base field.

notes: Primary NIST record also mentions extensions to Jacobi intersections and Huff curves.

applicability.p256: Research baseline, not a new coordinate formula.
